name: fritzing_analoggyro
description: Real 2-layer panelized board exported from Fritzing (analog gyro breakout): both copper layers, both masks, both silks, a board outline and a drill file.
notes: First Fritzing board in the corpus (a fourth CAD dialect after Eagle, DipTrace, pcb-tools). Files renamed from 'combined.*' to conventional extensions; content byte-identical. Added after #26 fixed the O(n^2) checks that made this panel slow (62 s -> ~14 s). On this board copper_sliver_width and min_trace_spacing fail; the min_trace_spacing reading of 0.026 mm was verified to sit among six distinct clustered copper features (a genuinely tight region), not a single-polygon artifact. Neither failing check is ground-truthed to a specific defect, so the overall verdict is intentionally not pinned -- only confident invariants are asserted.
